name: PILLAR
aliases: Mirabegron in patients aged 65 years or older
question: Does flexibly dosed mirabegron improve urgency incontinence and urinary frequency versus placebo in older adults with overactive bladder wet?

design.population: Community-dwelling adults aged at least 65 years with overactive bladder for at least 3 months, at least one incontinence and three urgency episodes over 3 days, and at least eight micturitions per 24 hours.
design.description: Multicenter, phase 4, double-blind randomized superiority trial
design.locator: Wagg 2020, PubMed abstract, Methods; Griebling 2020, Results and Table 1

verdictNote: Both coprimary 12-week diary endpoints improved versus placebo.
takeaway: In adults aged at least 65 years with overactive bladder wet, flexibly dosed mirabegron improved 12-week daily micturitions and incontinence episodes versus placebo; the primary report described both coprimary differences as statistically significant.

reports.label: Primary efficacy report
reports.citation: Wagg A, Staskin D, Engel E, et al. "Efficacy, safety, and tolerability of mirabegron in patients aged ≥65yr with overactive bladder wet: a phase IV, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled study (PILLAR)." *Eur Urol.* 2020;77(2):211-220. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2019.10.002

results.measure: Change in mean micturitions per 24 hours from baseline to end of treatment
results.note: The abstract reports statistical significance but no arm-specific changes or effect estimate.

results.measure: Change in mean incontinence episodes per 24 hours from baseline to end of treatment
results.note: The abstract reports statistical significance but no arm-specific changes or effect estimate.

results.measure: Mean voided volume per micturition and daily urgency and urgency-incontinence episodes
results.note: Each secondary measure was reported statistically significant in the abstract.

delivery.label: Dosing schedule
delivery.value: Mirabegron 25 mg daily or matched placebo for 12 weeks; optional dose increase to 50 mg after week 4 or 8.

reports.label: Prespecified cognitive analysis
reports.citation: Griebling TL, Campbell NL, Mangel J, et al. "Effect of mirabegron on cognitive function in elderly patients with overactive bladder: MoCA results from a phase 4 randomized, placebo-controlled study (PILLAR)." *BMC Geriatr.* 2020;20:109. doi:10.1186/s12877-020-1474-7

results.measure: Adjusted mean change in MoCA score from baseline to week 12
results.note: Prespecified safety analysis; the trial was not powered for a MoCA difference.

results.endpoint: MoCA decline of at least 4 points
results.measure: Patients with at least a 4-point MoCA decline by week 12
results.note: Post hoc minimum-detectable-change analysis; denominators have week-12 MoCA data.
results.locator: Full text, Results, MoCA score paragraph and Figure 2

reports.label: Detailed safety analysis
reports.citation: Herschorn S, Staskin D, Schermer CR, et al. "Safety and Tolerability Results from the PILLAR Study: A Phase IV, Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study of Mirabegron in Patients ≥65 years with Overactive Bladder-Wet." *Drugs Aging.* 2020;37(9):665-676. doi:10.1007/s40266-020-00783-w
reports.followUp: 12-week treatment; adverse events collected through week 16

harms.label: At least one treatment-emergent adverse event
harms.locator: Full text, Table 2; treated safety set
harms.note: Mirabegron total is the sum of 100/226 at 25 mg and 109/219 after escalation.

harms.label: Serious treatment-emergent adverse event
harms.locator: Full text, Table 2; treated safety set
harms.note: Mirabegron total is the sum of 7/226 and 8/219; no mirabegron-related serious event was identified.

harms.label: Urinary tract infection adverse event
harms.locator: Full text, Table 2; treated safety set
harms.note: Mirabegron total is the sum of 16/226 and 9/219.

harms.label: Urinary retention adverse event

harms.label: Increased blood pressure adverse event
harms.locator: Full text, Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events of Special Interest

delivery.note: Dose increase to 50 mg occurred at week 4 or 8.
